result.brief: 提出 DeltaRAE 因果视频表征自编码器，用导数式 tokenization 对锚帧全量编码、其余帧少量 token 编码，显著降低 token 与算力并支持一分钟长视频生成与预测。
result.reason: Causal representation autoencoder with derivative tokenization for video, built on frozen pretrained image encoder; directly a RAE/tokenizer and video representation contribution enabling long video generation.
